what: Over the page, a thin gradient ring follows the mouse each frame by .1 of the remaining distance, stretches in the direction of movement by lag distance × .001 (max .55) (horizontal 1+s, vertical 1−s), and tilts toward that direction. Normally its diameter is 0 so it is invisible, but over links and photos carrying data-cursor-label it grows to a 180px diameter in .7s, shows that text (‹View More›) in 1s, and reduces the stretch to 1/5. On entering and leaving the page it scales 1↔0 over .3s power2.inOut. The ring uses exclusion blending, so it shows as an inverted color over both light backgrounds and dark photos.

options.damp: Follow damping (share of remaining distance per frame), default .1
options.gain · max: Growing = Distance × gain, capped at max — default .001 · .55
options.calm: Multiplier applied to the growth while text is shown, default .2
options.[data-cursor-label]: Text to show on the link or photo inside the panel — the ring grows over this
options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Ring element (optional) — if missing, the part creates and attaches the ring (circle) and text (label)
options.--fx-ring: Ring and text color (css), default var(--kf-surface) — it uses exclusion, so white inverts the background beneath it

note: Not attached on touch devices or with reduced motion. The original keeps the ring always up at size 0 and only grows it over links, so on empty areas only the system cursor shows.

from.where: shared.js whole body — the ring grows over photo links (View More) · shop (Go to Shop) · next page (Next page)
